description: Chapter card: a huge outlined chapter number fills with an accent gradient from the bottom up, a rule draws, the 'CHAPTER 02' label tracks in and the chapter title rises out of masks; exits with a sideways mask slide. Transparent background (optional scrim).

params.number: Chapter number (shown zero-padded to 2 digits if numeric), default 1
params.title: Chapter title (auto-fit, max 2 lines)
params.label: Small label word, default 'Chapter'
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10
